ownerQuestion: Does the physical universe we inhabit contain one actual outcome history, or multiple physically real histories?
status: Candidate-specific theoretical and experimental question gate; no new central ontology score assigned

scorePolicy.meaning: Neutral editorial anchor, not a 50% observed probability
scorePolicy.mayMoveWith: Fully specified actually competing one-history and many-history predicted event distributions, independent physical data, confidence and alternative-model review; or model-averaged clearly qualified posterior with declared priors/parameter nuisance integration and sensitivity
scorePolicy.mustNotMoveWith: Paper counts, unspecified collapse exclusions, quantum Bell violations alone, source prestige, simulation counts, parameter cherry-picking
scorePolicy.pairedEquality: For standard Everett and Bohmian equilibrium with same Born preparation, L_E(data)/L_Beq(data)=1; no Bayesian update of their pairwise odds is possible from those measurements.
